instructions:
## Workspace files

Read and write files in the **current workspace** only.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description:
## Write a file

Creates or **overwrites** a file.

- `path`: where to write (relative to the workspace)
- `content`: UTF-8 text

> **Important:** existing files are replaced without a backup.

IMPORTANT: paths outside the workspace are rejected.

| Mode | Effect |
|------|--------|
| `w` | overwrite |
| `a` | append |

See the [docs](https://example.invalid/docs/write) for details.

```json
{"path": "notes/todo.md", "content": "- [ ] ship it"}
```
